description: Return an account's recorded supplier transfers for a period, each line with its machine-verification receipt. paid_at and the period use the payout time; accepted_at is the final's acceptance time, or null. Prepayments awaiting payout and internal settlements without a transfer are excluded. CSV cells that look like formulas are prefixed with a single quote.

agent_key.description: Agent key for an organization member.

from.description: Statement period start; defaults to the start of the current month.

to.description: Statement period end; defaults to now. The range must be under 366 days.

name: procurement_statement_get
title: Read an Itemized Procurement Statement
